title: THE MEDAL SPOT IS RESERVED
why: His answer of 2026-10-14: Halo puts medals in a row at the left, so room for a medal spot goes in the layout. A row between the feed and the vitals, the width of the feed and tall enough for the 48 pixel emblems, is reserved for the later medal polish and registered in the HUD table, so nothing else can draw there. The feed stands on it, so it moved up by that height; the row is empty until the emblems are drawn.
now: A row for the style medals is reserved between the feed and the vitals.
